capabilities: Create, open and delete a note attached to any folder
Choose where the folder note lives (inside, outside, or index file)
Keep folder and note names in sync when renaming either
Turn the current note into a folder with a command
Render card or strip overviews of folder contents via a ccard code block
extras: Not in the Obsidian community plugin list; installed via BRAT or manually from releases. Auto Rename is flagged experimental and may fail. Some ccard syntax details are deferred to external docs (ccard Syntax, ccard recipes).
intentEvidence: A revamp of xpgo's Folder Note plugin, kept working with current Obsidian.
motivation: The original Folder Note plugin by xpgo no longer loads in current Obsidian versions, so the author revived it with build and API fixes.
problem: Obsidian folders cannot hold a description note, and clicking a folder in the file explorer only expands it instead of opening an attached note.

relations.evidence: A revamp of xpgo's Folder Note plugin, kept working with current Obsidian.
The two plugins complement each other: Folder Note Revamped creates and manages the folder note, and Waypoint fills it with links

summary: Folder note plugin that attaches a note to any folder, opens it on folder click, and renders card-style overviews of folder contents.
